name: Social Media
author: yakuda
description: Your handles in the chatbox: Discord, TikTok, Spotify and Instagram - each one switchable on its own. Discord can additionally show the server and the voice channel you are sitting in right now, read live from the local Discord RPC socket (needs a Discord application of your own, no bot and no data leaves your machine except the one-time login). Everything else is plain text you type in once. All entries can rotate on a timer so the line stays short.
summary: Discord (live server/voice channel), TikTok, Spotify and Instagram handles - each switchable.

placeholders.sm_social: one enabled network at a time (rotating)
placeholders.sm_discord: Discord name, or server and voice channel while live
placeholders.sm_guild: Discord server you are connected to
placeholders.sm_channel: Discord voice channel you are sitting in

settings.label: Discord
settings.hint: Just the name, or the server and voice channel you are in right now

items.label: Discord enabled  –  {sm_discord}
items.hint: Nothing about Discord is shown or read while this is off

items.label: Discord name
items.hint: Your username or an invite like discord.gg/xxxx

items.label: What to show
items.hint: Live mode reads the local Discord app - the name above is used whenever you are not in a voice channel

items.label: Application-ID
items.hint: discord.com/developers -> New Application -> the Application ID. Only the owner of the app can use the rpc scope, so it has to be one of yours.

items.label: Client-Secret
items.hint: OAuth2 tab of the same app. Needed once for the login, stored in plain text in the plugin folder - never use someone else's secret.

items.label: Redirect-URI
items.hint: Add exactly this URI in the OAuth2 tab of your app - it is never opened, Discord only compares the string

items.label: Check interval
items.hint: How often the local Discord socket is asked. This never touches the internet.

items.label: Server / channel separator
items.hint: Between the server and the voice channel

items.label: Discord icon
items.hint: Prefix in front of the Discord entry, empty for none

items.label: Spotify name
items.hint: Your profile name. The song you are playing is the media card's job, not this one.

items.label: Rotate the networks  –  {sm_social}
items.hint: Only affects {sm_social}. Switched off it shows all enabled networks at once.

items.label: Seconds per network
items.hint: 10 seconds is the lowest the chatbox rate limit tolerates

items.label: Put @ in front of the handles
items.hint: TikTok, Instagram and the Discord name. Never for Spotify, for a pasted link or for the live server/channel.

items.label: Separator
items.hint: Between the networks in {social_media} and in a non-rotating {sm_social}

items.label: Entry length
items.hint: Longer entries are cut off - the chatbox has limited space
